name: T2 provenance chain over fixture 09
query: { sources(sort: [{canonicalUri: ASC}]) { uid canonicalUri sourceKind renditionOfPublication { uid } revisionEvents { revisionKind } snapshots { uid contentHashBasis locators { selectorKind section exact supports { __typename ... on Assertion { uid status } ... on Adjudication { uid adjudicationKind verdict } } } } } }

name: T2b answer activity authorized by policy (state 5)
query: { activities(where: {activityKind: {eq: ANSWER_COMPOSITION}}) { uid usedAssertions { uid } usedLocators { uid } authorizedByConnection { edges { properties { useKind } node { uid } } } associatedWithAgents { uid agentKind } } }

name: T2c adjudication supersession (SOURCE_REVISION)
query: { adjudications(where: {adjudicationKind: {eq: SUPPORT}}, sort: [{recordedAt: ASC}]) { uid verdict recordedAt supersedesConnection { edges { properties { supersessionKind sourceRevisionEventUid } node { uid verdict } } } evaluates { uid status } } }

name: T2d retraction assertion asserter via union
query: { assertions(where: {predicate: {eq: "RETRACTS_SOURCE"}}) { uid assertedBy { __typename ... on Organization { uid } } subject { __typename ... on Source { uid } } object { __typename ... on Source { uid } } } }
